context: This image is a character asset view: an isolated turnaround render on a plain neutral studio backdrop, as the project's view spec requires, not a gameplay screenshot. The scene, environment, sky and bloom of the reference are absent by design. Grade the character only, against the plush penguins in the reference: royal-blue plush body, white belly, orange beak and feet, pink sneakers, chunky toy-like proportions and the named costume.
